data.summary: Six actionable commitments were extracted from this product discussion between Austin Mejia and Andrei Ungureanu. Austin owns three follow-up actions: writing a PRD for the Chief of Staff feature, reaching out to identify who owns memory at the company, and writing up chip/block scenarios for FlashMemo. Andrei owns two actions: working on highlight functionality for FlashMemo and continuing work on MCP calendar/email integration tools. One commitment around raising concerns about command vs. to-do disambiguation is shared/unclear in ownership. No due dates were specified for any commitments, representing a notable gap.
